title: Last fragments

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Did you find any more fragments? Have you brought them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did you find any more fragments? Have you brought them?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: I’m fine, I’m fine, I just haven’t slept. Every time I close my eyes I see the patterns.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’m fine, I’m fine, I just haven’t slept. Every time I close my eyes I see the patterns.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: I don’t know exactly! Haha! It’s so difficult, and my pictorial Nivali was never very good… but so far I've got a series of images:

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don’t know exactly! Haha! It’s so difficult, and my pictorial Nivali was never very good… but so far I've got a series of images:

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: "Wisdom is the path to… fish? Old man loves birds?" I don’t know but I’m close, I can feel it. And if you have any more…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "Wisdom is the path to… fish? Old man loves birds?" I don’t know but I’m close, I can feel it. And if you have any more…

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: I can’t take a break! Not now. Don’t you understand? If I translate even a fraction of the Enchiridion...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can’t take a break! Not now. Don’t you understand? If I translate even a fraction of the Enchiridion...

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Look. I’m fine. I know what I’m doing. So do you have the fragments or not?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look. I’m fine. I know what I’m doing. So do you have the fragments or not?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: This could be it, this could be what I need. Look, there: that’s a skull isn't it? A mind? A face? And the circle. A mirror! CORA-be-thanked...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This could be it, this could be what I need. Look, there: that’s a skull isn't it? A mind? A face? And the circle. A mirror! CORA-be-thanked...

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: What? Why are you lying to me? You want them for yourself!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What? Why are you lying to me? You want them for yourself!

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: *sigh* Maybe you’re right. Maybe I have been staring at this thing too long. It gets into your brain. Like a parasite or something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: *sigh* Maybe you’re right. Maybe I have been staring at this thing too long. It gets into your brain. Like a parasite or something.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Throw it in the...?! This is a priceless artefact! The key to another world! I thought you understood.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Throw it in the...?! This is a priceless artefact! The key to another world! I thought you understood.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: You’re right. I should get some sleep. Thanks, I guess.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You’re right. I should get some sleep. Thanks, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: I can worry about myself, thanks. So will you give me the fragments? I know you have it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can worry about myself, thanks. So will you give me the fragments? I know you have it.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: You're worse than CorpSec. Next time you want answers, go find someone else. We're done.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're worse than CorpSec. Next time you want answers, go find someone else. We're done.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Huh? Yeah, yeah, careful, sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huh? Yeah, yeah, careful, sure.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: I don’t have time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don’t have time.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Fine, fine. You know the Gut Broker, Crogan? The one who was murdered?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine, fine. You know the Gut Broker, Crogan? The one who was murdered?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Fine. You know Quince Crogan, the Gut Broker?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine. You know Quince Crogan, the Gut Broker?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Well, I heard that before he died, he found something in the guts of a droid he was disassembling for parts. Something the person had swallowed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I heard that before he died, he found something in the guts of a droid he was disassembling for parts. Something the person had swallowed.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Well, I heard that he found something in the guts of a droid he was disassembling for parts. Something the person had swallowed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I heard that he found something in the guts of a droid he was disassembling for parts. Something the person had swallowed.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: I don’t know. But whatever it was, he was excited. He asked to come and speak to me about it, but was killed before he could. Whatever it is might still be in his shop.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don’t know. But whatever it was, he was excited. He asked to come and speak to me about it, but was killed before he could. Whatever it is might still be in his shop.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: But he was excited. He asked to come and speak to me about it but hasn't yet. Whatever it is might still be in his shop.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But he was excited. He asked to come and speak to me about it but hasn't yet. Whatever it is might still be in his shop.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Because if someone swallowed it, they wanted to hide it. Which means it's probably illegal. I have enough problems with CorpSec as it is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because if someone swallowed it, they wanted to hide it. Which means it's probably illegal. I have enough problems with CorpSec as it is.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Because it’s all I can offer in payment. Finding these pieces… I can’t express what it means. Thank you. I hope you find what you’re looking for.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because it’s all I can offer in payment. Finding these pieces… I can’t express what it means. Thank you. I hope you find what you’re looking for.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Me? Of course, I’m just an academic. What kind of trouble could I get into?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Me? Of course, I’m just an academic. What kind of trouble could I get into?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: He's a technician, has a shop in Industrial.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's a technician, has a shop in Industrial.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: You know I've deciphered some of the Enchiridion’s instructions?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know I've deciphered some of the Enchiridion’s instructions?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Old man, two parallel lines and a long-necked bird, like a heron or an egret? And a fish? I think?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Old man, two parallel lines and a long-necked bird, like a heron or an egret? And a fish? I think?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: No, I’ll be able to access the most powerful repository of knowledge about the city that’s ever existed!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, I’ll be able to access the most powerful repository of knowledge about the city that’s ever existed!

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Anyway, I heard that he found something in the guts of a droid he was disassembling for parts. Something the person had swallowed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anyway, I heard that he found something in the guts of a droid he was disassembling for parts. Something the person had swallowed.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: I don't know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Obviously.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Obviously.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: I know what I'm doing!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know what I'm doing!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you OK?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you OK?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What does it say?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What does it say?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nope, no idea what that means.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nope, no idea what that means.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Nope, no idea what that means.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Nope, no idea what that means.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think you should take a break from this for a while...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think you should take a break from this for a while...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think you should take a break from this for a while...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think you should take a break from this for a while...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I do.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It sounds dangerous.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It sounds dangerous.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, sorry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, sorry.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes, here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No. I think you're getting too obsessed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. I think you're getting too obsessed.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No. I think you're getting too obsessed.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No. I think you're getting too obsessed.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Taking a break won't hurt.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Taking a break won't hurt.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'd throw it in the sea.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd throw it in the sea.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'd throw it in the sea.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'd throw it in the sea.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I understand that it's something you shouldn't be messing with.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I understand that it's something you shouldn't be messing with.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I understand that it's something you shouldn't be messing with.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I understand that it's something you shouldn't be messing with.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm just worried about you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm just worried about you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Answer's still no.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Answer's still no.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fine, here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine, here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You'll be careful?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'll be careful?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And my secret?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And my secret?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You promised.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You promised.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How could I forget?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How could I forget?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Don't think so...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't think so...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How could I forget?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How could I forget?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What was it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What was it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So why haven't you looked for it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So why haven't you looked for it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So why haven't you looked for it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So why haven't you looked for it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why tell me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why tell me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What was it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What was it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You'll be careful?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'll be careful?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How are you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How are you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Patterns?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Patterns?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Doesn't sound good!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Doesn't sound good!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Old man uses crane to fish?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Old man uses crane to fish?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Old man uses crane to fish?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Old man uses crane to fish?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A cognitive test for dementia: Man, heron, fish ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A cognitive test for dementia: Man, heron, fish ...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: A cognitive test for dementia: Man, heron, fish ...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: A cognitive test for dementia: Man, heron, fish ...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You've gone mad?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You've gone mad?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ... you'll still be an unknown historian!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... you'll still be an unknown historian!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: ... you'll still be an unknown historian!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: ... you'll still be an unknown historian!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Droids swallow things?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Droids swallow things?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This thing has power over you...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This thing has power over you...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: This thing has power over you...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: This thing has power over you...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ... you'll reach enlightenment?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... you'll reach enlightenment?
